name: Kola Link identity-anchor
description: Lock a Bitcoin Cash output that commits to a Kola Link npub↔wallet binding, then rotate or revoke it.

holder.name: Holder
holder.description: The person who controls the bound Bitcoin Cash key.

receive.name: Receive
receive.description: Receive Bitcoin Cash that can later fund an identity anchor.

holder.name: Receive
holder.description: Receive Bitcoin Cash to this identity account.

bind.name: Bind
bind.description: Create an identity-anchor output that commits to a binding hash.

holder.name: Bind
holder.description: Fund a new identity-anchor output from this wallet.

rotate.name: Rotate
rotate.description: Replace the on-chain commitment with a new one, signed by the same holder key.

holder.name: Rotate
holder.description: Spend the current anchor into a new anchor with a new commitment.

revoke.name: Revoke
revoke.description: Spend the identity anchor back to a plain P2PKH address, ending the commitment.

holder.name: Revoke
holder.description: Close the on-chain identity commitment and recover the locked satoshis.

receiveTransaction.name: Received
receiveTransaction.description: Received funds into the holder wallet.

bindTransaction.name: Identity bound
bindTransaction.description: Created an identity-anchor output committing to $(<commitment>).

revokeTransaction.name: Identity revoked
revokeTransaction.description: Spent the identity anchor back to the holder.

anchorInput.name: Identity anchor
anchorInput.description: The current identity-anchor output being spent.

receiveOutput.name: Holder receive
receiveOutput.description: A standard P2PKH output owned by the holder.

anchorOutput.name: Identity anchor
anchorOutput.description: Output whose redeem script commits to the binding hash.

rotatedAnchorOutput.name: Rotated identity anchor
rotatedAnchorOutput.description: A new identity-anchor output with the replacement commitment.

revokeOutput.name: Revoked funds
revokeOutput.description: Satoshis recovered by the holder after revoking the anchor.

identityAnchor.name: Identity anchor
identityAnchor.description: P2SH redeem script that commits to a binding hash and requires the holder signature.

rotatedAnchor.name: Rotated identity anchor
rotatedAnchor.description: The identity-anchor script after a rotation, committing to newCommitment.

scripts.lockIdentityAnchor: <commitment> OP_DROP OP_DUP OP_HASH160 <$(<holderKey.public_key> OP_HASH160)> OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_CHECKSIG
scripts.lockRotatedAnchor: <newCommitment> OP_DROP OP_DUP OP_HASH160 <$(<holderKey.public_key> OP_HASH160)> OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_CHECKSIG

minerFeeSatoshis.name: Miner fee
minerFeeSatoshis.description: Satoshis reserved for the rotate or revoke transaction fee.

holderKey.name: Holder key
holderKey.description: The private key that controls the identity anchor.

commitment.name: Binding commitment
commitment.description: sha256 of the canonical Kola Link binding statement (32 bytes).

newCommitment.name: New binding commitment
newCommitment.description: Replacement sha256 commitment written by a rotate.

anchorSatoshis.name: Anchor amount
anchorSatoshis.description: Satoshis locked in the identity-anchor output. Keep this above the dust limit.

resources.name: Kola Link specification (KL-1)
resources.description: Canonical binding statement, proofs, and verification rules.
